messages:
Jason (Sales): AtlasRetail (CUST-11021) flagged an overage on INV-2026-0628. They spun up a test cluster and forgot to tag it as non-billable; usage shows $3,500 in unexpected charges. Asking for refund or account credit. Link to ticket: https://support.redwood/t/10421
Sophie (Billing): Pulling invoice now. I see the compute line for untagged cluster - $3,500. Policy: credits under $5k handled by billing, but we track yearly goodwill total per customer. Need finance approval to proceed and confirm credit method.
finance-bot: Noted. Current goodwill YTD for CUST-11021: $1,800. Remaining cap before exec review: $3,200.
Maria L.: Thanks. Since requested amount $3,500 > remaining cap $3,200, this needs exec approval for exceeding annual goodwill threshold. Recommend splitting: apply $3,200 as account credit now and escalate remaining $300 to CFO approval? Or ask customer if account credit + one-time refund works. Thoughts?
Jason (Sales): Customer prefers full refund to card, they say they cannot wait. They are a high-touch account; refund keeps renewal smooth.
CFO - Priya: I can approve the full $3,500 as a one-off goodwill refund given ARR and churn risk. Please include clear memo and tag relationship owner. Use GL 6350 (Customer Refunds). Sophie, proceed with refund to card and post AR adjustment.
Sophie (Billing): Approved by CFO. Will issue refund REF-2026-204 and post CM-2026-1204 for audit. Draft ledger entry:
```
Date: 2026-06-15
Account: 6350 - Customer Refunds
Customer: CUST-11021 (AtlasRetail)
Amount: -3,500.00
Memo: Goodwill refund	6 overage from untagged test cluster on INV-2026-0628
Reference: REF-2026-204 / CM-2026-1204
```
Processing refund to the card used on file. Will cc Jason on customer communication.
finance-bot: Refund REF-2026-204 initiated. Payment processor ETA 3-5 business days.
Jason (Sales): Customer confirmed they'll watch for refund. Thank you. I'll note this on renewal.
Maria L.: Logging ENG ticket ENG-5299 to add stronger safeguards: 1) block billing for clusters labeled "test" unless billing-toggle enabled; 2) weekly untagged-resource report to customers.
Sophie (Billing): CM-2026-1204 posted and GL 6350 used. Audit link: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1204. Marking billing side complete.
finance-bot: Closed task BT-2026-412.
Jason (Sales): Resolved from customer side. Thanks team.
Maria L.: Thread closed. Action items: ENG-5299, refund posted, customer notified. :white_check_mark:
